AS $function$

         d.revoked_at::text, a.status as account_status,

           from garimpa.app_user_role aur
           join garimpa.affiliate_membership am

  from garimpa.extension_device d
  join garimpa.affiliate_account a on a.id = d.affiliate_id
  where d.token_hash = p_token_hash

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION garimpa.monitoring_account_state(p_tenant text, p_marketplace text)
 RETURNS TABLE(affiliate_id text, account_status text, enabled boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'garimpa'
AS $function$
begin
 if current_setting('garimpa.actor_type',true) is distinct from 'worker'
    or nullif(current_setting('garimpa.tenant_id',true),'') is null
    or current_setting('garimpa.tenant_id',true) is distinct from p_tenant then
  raise exception 'monitoring_worker_scope_required';
 end if;
 return query select a.id,a.status,p.enabled from garimpa.affiliate_account a
  left join garimpa.affiliate_monitoring_policy p on p.affiliate_id=a.id and p.marketplace=p_marketplace
  where a.tenant_id=p_tenant;
end $function$

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'garimpa'
AS $function$ begin
 if new.tenant_id is distinct from old.tenant_id then raise exception 'tenant_immutable'; end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION garimpa.protect_price_policy_version()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'garimpa'
AS $function$ begin
 if old.status='approved' and (new.config is distinct from old.config or new.version is distinct from old.version
  or new.approved_by is distinct from old.approved_by or new.approved_at is distinct from old.approved_at
  or new.status not in ('approved','retired')) then raise exception 'approved_policy_immutable'; end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION garimpa.public_catalog(p_tenant text, q jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'garimpa'
AS $function$
 with selected as(select id,version from garimpa.editorial_selection where tenant_id=p_tenant and status='active' and valid_until>now() order by version desc limit 1),
 filtered as (
  select f.*,item.position from garimpa.public_offer_rows(p_tenant) f
  left join garimpa.editorial_selection_item item on item.product_id=f.id and item.tenant_id=f.tenant_id and item.selection_id=(select id from selected) and 'home'=any(item.destinations)
  where (q->>'category' is null or f.category=q->>'category') and (q->>'search' is null or f.title ilike '%'||(q->>'search')||'%')
   and (q->>'marketplace' is null or f.marketplace=q->>'marketplace')
   and (q->>'minPriceCents' is null or f.price_cents>=(q->>'minPriceCents')::int)
   and (q->>'maxPriceCents' is null or f.price_cents<=(q->>'maxPriceCents')::int)
   and (q->>'minRating' is null or f.rating_star>=(q->>'minRating')::numeric)
   and (q->>'minDiscount' is null or f.claimed_discount_rate>=(q->>'minDiscount')::numeric/100)
   and (not coalesce((q->>'lowestOnly')::boolean,false) or f.lowest_verified)
   and (not coalesce((q->>'hasHistory')::boolean,false) or (f.observation_count>=3 and f.history_days>=7))
   and (q->>'freshnessDays' is null or f.evidence_observed_at>=now()-least(7,(q->>'freshnessDays')::int)*interval '1 day')
 ), paged as(select * from filtered order by
   case when coalesce(q->>'sort','signal')='signal' then position end nulls last,
   case when q->>'sort'='price' then price_cents end asc nulls last,
   case when q->>'sort'='popularity' then sales_count end desc nulls last,
   evidence_observed_at desc,id limit least(24,greatest(1,coalesce((q->>'limit')::int,12))) offset greatest(0,coalesce((q->>'offset')::int,0)))
 select jsonb_build_object('deals',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)-'tenant_id'-'publication_id'-'position') from paged p),'[]'::jsonb),
  'total',(select count(*) from filtered),'selectionVersion',(select version from selected),'selectionStateKey','public-v1');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION garimpa.public_deal_detail(p_slug text)

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'garimpa'
AS $function$

   select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('price_cents',o.price_cents,'observed_at',o.observed_at) order by o.observed_at,o.id)
   from garimpa.price_observation o
   where o.product_id=f.id and o.tenant_id=f.tenant_id and o.observed_at>=now()-interval '90 days' and o.price_cents>0

 ),'[]'::jsonb))

 where f.slug=p_slug limit 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION garimpa.public_offer_rows(p_tenant text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, tenant_id text, publication_id text, title text, image_url text, category text, marketplace text, slug text, price_cents integer, original_price_cents integer, claimed_discount_rate double precision, rating_star double precision, sales_label text, sales_count integer, evidence_observed_at timestamp with time zone, min_price_cents integer, previous_min_price_cents integer, observation_count integer, history_days integer, lowest_verified boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'garimpa'
AS $function$
 select f.id,f.tenant_id,pub.id,f.title,f.image_url,f.category,f.marketplace,pub.slug,
 f.price_cents,f.original_price_cents,f.claimed_discount_rate,f.rating_star,f.sales_label,f.sales_count,f.observed_at,
 f.previous_min_price_cents,f.previous_min_price_cents,f.observation_count,f.history_days,f.lowest_verified
 from garimpa.curation_queue_facts f
 join lateral(select p.* from garimpa.publication p join garimpa.affiliate_account a on a.id=p.affiliate_id and a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and a.status='active'
   where p.product_id=f.id and p.tenant_id=f.tenant_id and p.channel='web' and p.status='active' order by p.published_at desc,p.id limit 1) pub on true
 where f.status='approved' and f.price_cents>0 and f.last_seen_at>=now()-interval '7 days'
   and (p_tenant is null or f.tenant_id=p_tenant);
$function$
functions.prosrc:
select f.id,f.tenant_id,pub.id,f.title,f.image_url,f.category,f.marketplace,pub.slug,
 f.price_cents,f.original_price_cents,f.claimed_discount_rate,f.rating_star,f.sales_label,f.sales_count,f.observed_at,
 f.previous_min_price_cents,f.previous_min_price_cents,f.observation_count,f.history_days,f.lowest_verified
 from garimpa.curation_queue_facts f
 join lateral(select p.* from garimpa.publication p join garimpa.affiliate_account a on a.id=p.affiliate_id and a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and a.status='active'
   where p.product_id=f.id and p.tenant_id=f.tenant_id and p.channel='web' and p.status='active' order by p.published_at desc,p.id limit 1) pub on true
 where f.status='approved' and f.price_cents>0 and f.last_seen_at>=now()-interval '7 days'
   and (p_tenant is null or f.tenant_id=p_tenant);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION garimpa.resolve_actor_accounts(p_auth_user_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(affiliate_id text, tenant_id text, public_slug text, display_name text, account_status text, membership_role text, app_user_id text, app_role text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'garimpa', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select
    a.id as affiliate_id,
    a.tenant_id,
    a.public_slug,
    a.display_name,
    a.status as account_status,
    m.role as membership_role,
    u.id as app_user_id,
    coalesce(r.role::text, 'comprador') as app_role
  from garimpa.app_user u
  join garimpa.affiliate_membership m on m.app_user_id = u.id and m.revoked_at is null
  join garimpa.affiliate_account a on a.id = m.affiliate_id and a.status = 'active'
  left join garimpa.app_user_role r on r.app_user_id = u.id and r.revoked_at is null and r.role = 'afiliado'
  where u.auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id
  order by (a.id = 'aff_local') desc, a.created_at asc;
$function$
functions.prosrc:
select
    a.id as affiliate_id,
    a.tenant_id,
    a.public_slug,
    a.display_name,
    a.status as account_status,
    m.role as membership_role,
    u.id as app_user_id,
    coalesce(r.role::text, 'comprador') as app_role
  from garimpa.app_user u
  join garimpa.affiliate_membership m on m.app_user_id = u.id and m.revoked_at is null
  join garimpa.affiliate_account a on a.id = m.affiliate_id and a.status = 'active'
  left join garimpa.app_user_role r on r.app_user_id = u.id and r.revoked_at is null and r.role = 'afiliado'
  where u.auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id
  order by (a.id = 'aff_local') desc, a.created_at asc;

AS $function$
declare bytes bytea:=convert_to(p_text,'UTF8'); result text:=''; b int; i int; begin
 for i in 0..length(bytes)-1 loop b:=get_byte(bytes,i);
  result:=result||case when (b between 48 and 57) or (b between 65 and 90) or (b between 97 and 122) or b in (45,46,95,126) then chr(b) else '%'||upper(lpad(to_hex(b),2,'0')) end;
 end loop; return result;
end $function$

views.name: curation_queue_facts
views.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (price_observation.product_id) price_observation.id,
            price_observation.tenant_id,
            price_observation.product_id,
            price_observation.price_cents,
            price_observation.original_price_cents,
            price_observation.claimed_discount_rate,
            price_observation.observed_at,
            price_observation.rating_star,
            price_observation.sales_label,
            price_observation.sales_count,
            price_observation.capture_run_id,
            price_observation.title_snapshot,
            price_observation.product_url_snapshot,
            price_observation.image_url_snapshot,
            price_observation.category_snapshot,
            price_observation.capture_source,
            price_observation.extension_device_id,
            price_observation.client_request_id,
            price_observation.source_page_url,
            price_observation.client_captured_at,
            price_observation.received_at,
            price_observation.offer_evidence
           FROM garimpa.price_observation
          ORDER BY price_observation.product_id, price_observation.observed_at DESC, price_observation.id DESC
        ), policy AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (effective_price_evidence_policy.tenant_id) effective_price_evidence_policy.tenant_id,
            effective_price_evidence_policy.config
           FROM garimpa.effective_price_evidence_policy
          WHERE effective_price_evidence_policy.status = 'approved'::text
          ORDER BY effective_price_evidence_policy.tenant_id, effective_price_evidence_policy.created_at DESC, effective_price_evidence_policy.id DESC
        ), first_run AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (price_observation.product_id) price_observation.product_id,
            price_observation.capture_run_id
           FROM garimpa.price_observation
          WHERE price_observation.capture_run_id IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY price_observation.product_id, price_observation.observed_at, price_observation.id
        )
 SELECT p.id,
    p.tenant_id,
    p.marketplace,
    p.external_id,
    p.title,
    p.product_url,
    p.image_url,
    p.category,
    p.last_seen_at,
    p.family_key,
    p.family_label,
    p.family_method,
    p.family_version,
    c.status,
    c.reason_code,
    c.reason_detail,
    c.deferred_until,
    c.created_at AS queued_at,
    l.price_cents,
    l.original_price_cents,
    l.claimed_discount_rate,
    l.rating_star,
    l.sales_label,
    l.sales_count,
    l.observed_at,
    totals.observation_count,
    totals.history_days,
    prior.previous_min_price_cents,
    COALESCE((pol.config ->> 'e3Enabled'::text)::boolean, false) AND l.observed_at <= now() AND now() < (l.observed_at + COALESCE((pol.config ->> 'maxAgeHours'::text)::numeric, 48::numeric)::double precision * '01:00:00'::interval) AND l.price_cents > 0 AND prior.comparable_count >= COALESCE((pol.config ->> 'minimumPriorCount'::text)::integer, 3) AND prior.distinct_days >= COALESCE((pol.config ->> 'minimumDistinctDays'::text)::integer, 3) AND (prior.covered_buckets::numeric / GREATEST(1::numeric, ceil(cfg.window_days * 24::numeric / cfg.bucket_hours))) >= COALESCE((pol.config ->> 'minimumCoverageRatio'::text)::numeric, 0.7) AND gaps.max_gap <= COALESCE((pol.config ->> 'maximumGapHours'::text)::numeric, 72::numeric) AND prior.previous_min_price_cents IS NOT NULL AND l.price_cents <= prior.previous_min_price_cents AS lowest_verified,
    fr.capture_run_id AS presenting_capture_run_id,
    run.marketplace AS presenting_marketplace,
    run.parameters ->> 'capturePlanId'::text AS presenting_plan_id,
    run.parameters ->> 'captureQueryId'::text AS presenting_query_id,
    run.parameters ->> 'captureMode'::text AS presenting_mode,
    run.parameters ->> 'targetCategory'::text AS presenting_target_category,
    run.parameters ->> 'targetFamily'::text AS presenting_target_family,
    run.parameters ->> 'executionId'::text AS presenting_execution_id,
    run.collector_run_id AS presenting_collector_run_id,
    run.started_at AS presenting_captured_at
   FROM garimpa.product p
     JOIN garimpa.product_curation c ON c.product_id = p.id AND c.tenant_id = p.tenant_id
     JOIN latest l ON l.product_id = p.id AND l.tenant_id = p.tenant_id
     LEFT JOIN policy pol ON pol.tenant_id = p.tenant_id
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT GREATEST(1::numeric, COALESCE((pol.config ->> 'windowDays'::text)::numeric, 30::numeric)) AS window_days,
            GREATEST(0.01, COALESCE((pol.config ->> 'bucketHours'::text)::numeric, 24::numeric)) AS bucket_hours) cfg
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS observation_count,
            floor(EXTRACT(epoch FROM l.observed_at - min(o.observed_at)) / 86400::numeric)::integer AS history_days
           FROM garimpa.price_observation o
          WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND o.tenant_id = p.tenant_id) totals
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( WITH comparable AS (
                 SELECT o.id,
                    o.tenant_id,
                    o.product_id,
                    o.price_cents,
                    o.original_price_cents,
                    o.claimed_discount_rate,
                    o.observed_at,
                    o.rating_star,
                    o.sales_label,
                    o.sales_count,
                    o.capture_run_id,
                    o.title_snapshot,
                    o.product_url_snapshot,
                    o.image_url_snapshot,
                    o.category_snapshot,
                    o.capture_source,
                    o.extension_device_id,
                    o.client_request_id,
                    o.source_page_url,
                    o.client_captured_at,
                    o.received_at,
                    o.offer_evidence
                   FROM garimpa.price_observation o
                  WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND o.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND o.id <> l.id AND o.price_cents > 0 AND o.observed_at < l.observed_at AND o.observed_at >= (l.observed_at - cfg.window_days::double precision * '1 day'::interval) AND (l.offer_evidence ->> 'currency'::text) IS NOT NULL AND (o.offer_evidence ->> 'currency'::text) = (l.offer_evidence ->> 'currency'::text) AND garimpa.offer_configuration_key(l.offer_evidence) IS NOT NULL AND garimpa.offer_configuration_key(o.offer_evidence) = garimpa.offer_configuration_key(l.offer_evidence)
                )
         SELECT min(comparable.price_cents) AS previous_min_price_cents,
            count(*)::integer AS comparable_count,
            count(DISTINCT (comparable.observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)::date)::integer AS distinct_days,
            count(DISTINCT floor(EXTRACT(epoch FROM comparable.observed_at - (l.observed_at - cfg.window_days::double precision * '1 day'::interval)) / (cfg.bucket_hours * 3600::numeric)))::integer AS covered_buckets
           FROM comparable) prior
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT max(EXTRACT(epoch FROM ordered.next_time - ordered.observed_at) / 3600::numeric) AS max_gap
           FROM ( SELECT points.observed_at,
                    lead(points.observed_at) OVER (ORDER BY points.observed_at) AS next_time
                   FROM ( SELECT l.observed_at - cfg.window_days::double precision * '1 day'::interval AS observed_at
                        UNION ALL
                         SELECT l.observed_at
                        UNION ALL
                         SELECT o.observed_at
                           FROM garimpa.price_observation o
                          WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND o.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND o.id <> l.id AND o.price_cents > 0 AND o.observed_at < l.observed_at AND o.observed_at >= (l.observed_at - cfg.window_days::double precision * '1 day'::interval) AND (l.offer_evidence ->> 'currency'::text) IS NOT NULL AND (o.offer_evidence ->> 'currency'::text) = (l.offer_evidence ->> 'currency'::text) AND garimpa.offer_configuration_key(l.offer_evidence) IS NOT NULL AND garimpa.offer_configuration_key(o.offer_evidence) = garimpa.offer_configuration_key(l.offer_evidence)) points) ordered) gaps
     LEFT JOIN first_run fr ON fr.product_id = p.id
     LEFT JOIN garimpa.capture_run run ON run.id = fr.capture_run_id AND run.tenant_id = p.tenant_id;

views.name: effective_price_evidence_policy
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    tenant_id,
    version,
    status,
    created_at,
    jsonb_set(config, '{e3Enabled}'::text[], to_jsonb(COALESCE((config ->> 'e3Enabled'::text) = 'true'::text, false) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM garimpa.price_calibration_run c
          WHERE c.id = p.calibration_run_id AND c.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND c.policy_version = p.version AND c.synthetic = false AND c.policy_snapshot = p.config AND (c.results ->> 'experiment'::text) = 'EXP-02'::text AND (c.results ->> 'reviewed'::text) = 'true'::text AND (c.results ->> 'pass'::text) = 'true'::text)))) AS config
   FROM garimpa.price_evidence_policy_version p;
